item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel D: The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2042 date comes from…
item.description: The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2042 date comes from the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance. That was wrong. The Port's 2017 staff report (Item 9B, p.7) puts the Schedule of Performance in the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA) between the Port and the developer, which is a different agreement from the Development Agreement between the City and the developer. The report says the developer must complete phase 3 within approximately 25 years of project approval, but it never states the year 2042; 2042 is Pier & Point's own arithmetic (2017 plus 25 years). It stays labelled a legal outside date, not an expected completion. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel D: The 2042 date shown for Parcel D is not a deadline for this parcel…
item.description: The 2042 date shown for Parcel D is not a deadline for this parcel, which is in Phase 1; it is Pier & Point's arithmetic for the whole project's final-phase outside date in the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA)'s Schedule of Performance, which is separate from the City's Development Agreement. It remains labelled a legal outside date, not a forecast. Source: Port of San Francisco, Item 9B: Pier 70 Mixed-Use Project approvals, Sep 22, 2017 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Item 11A: Pier 70 28-Acre Site Project update, Aug 7, 2026 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel D: The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion
item.description: The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 3 within approximately 25 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel D: The 2042 completion milestone is now a soft placeholder (the 2017…
item.description: The 2042 completion milestone is now a soft placeholder (the 2017 Phase 3 outside date, tolled by down market delay) instead of a forecast, and the claim that the Phase 1 schedule had lapsed was removed. The Item 11A milestone is dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report rather than as a hearing that took place, and 'since 2022' was dropped from the Port's statement. The map notes now cite the architect's own page for the design, describe the July 2026 Real Deal report accurately, and no longer claim the site was never subdivided by the Assessor. The Mayor's signing entry now states the Board of Supervisors' first-reading vote on Oct 31, 2017 and final passage on Nov 14, 2017. Source: Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Stanley Saitowitz | Natoma Architects, Pier 70 Parcel D (https://www.saitowitz.com/pier-70-parcel-d); The Real Deal, 2026-07-16 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2026/07/16/brookfield-wants-more-apartments-at-pier-70-project/); San Francisco Board of Supervisors, Ordinance No. 224-17 (https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/o0224-17.pdf).

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel D: Port Commission: Port staff and the… (late 2026 or early 2027)
item.description: Port Commission: Port staff and the developer are drafting amendments to the DDA and related transaction documents "for consideration by the Port Commission and Board of Supervisors by the end of this year or early next year" (Item 11A, memo of Aug 7, 2026, p.2 and p.6). Port Commission minutes of Aug 11, 2026 (p.7): staff and Brookfield "expect to return with proposed amendments in late 2026 or early 2027". The source gives no hearing date. The date shown is the early end of that window (December 2026); "early next year" falls in 2027. The same report proposes extending the term of the DDA, Development Agreement and Master Lease by 5 years. (late 2026 or early 2027). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel D: Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) for the Aug… (Aug 7, 2026)
item.description: Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) for the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission meeting (informational item 11A) describes proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 7, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11

item.title: Planned · Pier 70 Parcel D: Port reports (Aug 7, 2026 staff report, p.1) that its… (Aug 7, 2026)
item.description: Port reports (Aug 7, 2026 staff report, p.1) that its developer 'has successfully completed Phase 1 horizontal infrastructure and the rehabilitation of historic Building 12', while 'construction of Phase 1 vertical projects and parks has not moved forward' because of pandemic-driven office-vacancy increases (from just under 5% to a peak of 36%), a 20-30% escalation in construction costs and higher interest rates; the report adds (p.3) that the balance of the Phase 1 horizontal improvements, largely the Phase 1 parks and open space, 'will be constructed on a schedule that coincides with the delivery of adjacent vertical development' (Aug 7, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel D: Then the Board of Supervisors: the same amendments are to… (~Dec 2026)
item.description: Then the Board of Supervisors: the same amendments are to go to the Board of Supervisors in the same window (Item 11A, p.6: "for consideration by the Port Commission and Board of Supervisors by the end of this year or early next year"). The source gives no separate date or order for the Board. The date shown is the early end of the window; "early next year" falls in 2027. (~Dec 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel D: The Phase 1 down market delay, which tolls the… (Dec 26, 2026)
item.description: The Phase 1 down market delay, which tolls the developer's time-sensitive DDA obligations including close of escrow on option parcels, is extended to December 26, 2026: it reached its 60-month maximum in June 2026 and the parties agreed to extend it six months to allow time to complete the DDA amendments (Item 11A, memo of Aug 7, 2026, p.4: "the parties mutually agreed to extend the down market delay for an additional six months to December 26, 2026"). This is the end date of an extension the parties agreed under the DDA; the report does not call it a deadline, and it is not a forecast. (Dec 26, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel D: Proposed DDA amendment (not adopted): developer must close… (~2029)
item.description: Proposed DDA amendment (not adopted): developer must close escrow on remaining Phase 1 parcels A, C2B and D "by 2029-2030" or the Port will publicly offer them (Port Item 11A, p.5). The date shown is the first year of that range; this is a proposed outside date, not a schedule (~2029). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel D: Parcel D is a Phase 1 parcel (Port Item 11A, Aug 2026, p.5)… (~2042)
item.description: Parcel D is a Phase 1 parcel (Port Item 11A, Aug 2026, p.5): its own DDA outside dates are Phase 1 dates, and its Phase 1 schedule is tolled and vertical construction has not moved forward. 2042 is not a deadline for this parcel: it is Pier & Point's arithmetic for the DDA's Phase 3 outside date (approximately 25 years after Project approval; the Port's report states no calendar year), shown only as the project's outermost bound (~2042). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07

item.description: Phase 1 down market delay reaches its 60-month maximum; the parties extend it by six months to December 26, 2026 while DDA amendments are drafted (~Jun 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel D: Work on the 28-acre project stalls after the Phase 1… (~Apr 2022)
item.description: Work on the 28-acre project stalls after the Phase 1 infrastructure is built (Bisnow, Oct 20, 2022: 'a work stoppage earlier this year' and 'progress stalled in April, with officials citing market conditions'; the month is Bisnow's alone and refers to the 28-acre project's first phase, not to this parcel specifically). The Phase 1 parks and open space are still to be built (Port Item 11A, Aug 2026, p.3) (~Apr 2022). Source: Bisnow (Joseph Gordon), 2022-10-20; The Real Deal (citing SF Business Times), 2023-04-17; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.
